The maximum value the DTC Fault Detection Counter has reached during current op-
eration cycle.

⌈If the UDS DTC of [ [SWS_Dem_00788]] is referenced by multiple events or an com-

[SWS_Dem_00790]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04125
⌈The maximum FDC during current operation cycle shall be reset to zero with each
restart operation cycle (refer to DemOperationCycleRef).⌋
[SWS_Dem_00791]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04125
⌈The maximum FDC during current operation cycle shall be update if the current fault
detection counter value is greater than the current value of the maximum FDC during
current operation cycle.⌋
The maximum value the DTC Fault Detection Counter has reached since the last time
DTC information was cleared.
[SWS_Dem_00792]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04125
⌈If the maximum FDC since last clear is mapped to an extended data record (Dem-
InternalDataElement set to DEM_MAX_FDC_SINCE_LAST_CLEAR), it shall be
available for all events referencing a UDS DTC.⌋

Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04125
⌈If the UDS DTC of [SWS_Dem_00792] is referenced by multiple events or an com-
bined DTC, the event with the highest maximum FDC value shall be used to report.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00794]
